name: npmscan
description: Detect malicious, vulnerable, or typosquatted npm packages from a conversation. Search the npm registry; inspect maintainers, install scripts, and Sigstore publish provenance before installing; audit a whole package.json/lockfile/SBOM — including transitive dependencies, license compliance, and before/after PR diffs — against OSV.dev / GitHub Security Advisories / NIST NVD (with CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS enrichment); then get a prioritized remediation ranking and safer-alternative suggestions — via npmscan.com's free, read-only MCP server.
